description: This PHP source file 'buildEdit.php' is part of the TestLink open source test management system. It handles creating, editing, updating, and deleting build records, including managing build properties, copying configurations, and rendering the associated GUI. The file also includes utility functions for initializing arguments, checking permissions, and managing source build selectors.

classes.name: stdClass
classes.description: Generic PHP standard object used as a flexible container for various data passing between functions.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes request and session parameters into an arguments object, including date conversion and test plan resolution.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Initializes the GUI object with labels, custom fields, and filters based on input arguments and build manager data.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Prepares and returns data necessary for editing an existing build, including fetching current build info and setting up form data.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Sets up default data and labels for creating a new build.

methods.name: doDelete
methods.description: Deletes a specified build if no dependencies or constraints prevent it, and logs the event.

methods.name: renderGui
methods.description: Handles rendering the GUI for create, edit, or confirmation screens, managing templates, form inputs, and dynamic content.

methods.name: doCreate
methods.description: Processes the creation of a new build, including linked custom fields, date setting, and optionally copying test cases. Returns operation status.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Updates an existing build with new data, validates input, and logs changes.

methods.name: crossChecks
methods.description: Performs validation such as duplicate build name and valid release date before create or update operations.

methods.name: doCopyToTestPlans
methods.description: Copies the build to other test plans within the same project, avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks user permissions for build creation within the current test plan context.

methods.name: init_source_build_selector
methods.description: Initializes the dropdown menu with existing builds for copying test assignments when creating a new build.
